proposed_sonic_signature: Owners single out a wide, stable stereo image. Sweet top with clearer, more defined highs than the 2230, and a full, slightly loose low end. Sounds bigger than its 18-22 W rating; in a switch-box test it made a G-8700DB sound thin.
notes: 2SC871 transistors go noisy with age - restore first.
